import { sql } from 'drizzle-orm'
import {
  index,
  integer,
  real,
  sqliteTable,
  text,
} from 'drizzle-orm/sqlite-core'

import type { MatchedMetadata } from '#/lib/books'

// Better Auth tables (core + `username` and `admin` plugins).
// Keep in sync with the plugins configured in src/lib/auth.ts.

export const user = sqliteTable('user', {
  id: text('id').primaryKey(),
  name: text('name').notNull(),
  email: text('email').notNull().unique(),
  emailVerified: integer('email_verified', { mode: 'boolean' })
    .default(false)
    .notNull(),
  image: text('image'),
  createdAt: integer('created_at', { mode: 'timestamp_ms' })
    .default(sql`(cast(unixepoch('subsecond') * 1000 as integer))`)
    .notNull(),
  updatedAt: integer('updated_at', { mode: 'timestamp_ms' })
    .default(sql`(cast(unixepoch('subsecond') * 1000 as integer))`)
    .$onUpdate(() => new Date())
    .notNull(),
  username: text('username').unique(),
  displayUsername: text('display_username'),
  role: text('role'),
  banned: integer('banned', { mode: 'boolean' }).default(false),
  banReason: text('ban_reason'),
  banExpires: integer('ban_expires', { mode: 'timestamp_ms' }),
})

export const session = sqliteTable(
  'session',
  {
    id: text('id').primaryKey(),
    expiresAt: integer('expires_at', { mode: 'timestamp_ms' }).notNull(),
    token: text('token').notNull().unique(),
    createdAt: integer('created_at', { mode: 'timestamp_ms' })
      .default(sql`(cast(unixepoch('subsecond') * 1000 as integer))`)
      .notNull(),
    updatedAt: integer('updated_at', { mode: 'timestamp_ms' })
      .$onUpdate(() => new Date())
      .notNull(),
    ipAddress: text('ip_address'),
    userAgent: text('user_agent'),
    userId: text('user_id')
      .notNull()
      .references(() => user.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
    impersonatedBy: text('impersonated_by'),
  },
  (table) => [index('session_user_id_idx').on(table.userId)],
)

export const account = sqliteTable(
  'account',
  {
    id: text('id').primaryKey(),
    accountId: text('account_id').notNull(),
    providerId: text('provider_id').notNull(),
    userId: text('user_id')
      .notNull()
      .references(() => user.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
    accessToken: text('access_token'),
    refreshToken: text('refresh_token'),
    idToken: text('id_token'),
    accessTokenExpiresAt: integer('access_token_expires_at', {
      mode: 'timestamp_ms',
    }),
    refreshTokenExpiresAt: integer('refresh_token_expires_at', {
      mode: 'timestamp_ms',
    }),
    scope: text('scope'),
    password: text('password'),
    createdAt: integer('created_at', { mode: 'timestamp_ms' })
      .default(sql`(cast(unixepoch('subsecond') * 1000 as integer))`)
      .notNull(),
    updatedAt: integer('updated_at', { mode: 'timestamp_ms' })
      .$onUpdate(() => new Date())
      .notNull(),
  },
  (table) => [index('account_user_id_idx').on(table.userId)],
)

export const verification = sqliteTable(
  'verification',
  {
    id: text('id').primaryKey(),
    identifier: text('identifier').notNull(),
    value: text('value').notNull(),
    expiresAt: integer('expires_at', { mode: 'timestamp_ms' }).notNull(),
    createdAt: integer('created_at', { mode: 'timestamp_ms' })
      .default(sql`(cast(unixepoch('subsecond') * 1000 as integer))`)
      .notNull(),
    updatedAt: integer('updated_at', { mode: 'timestamp_ms' })
      .default(sql`(cast(unixepoch('subsecond') * 1000 as integer))`)
      .$onUpdate(() => new Date())
      .notNull(),
  },
  (table) => [index('verification_identifier_idx').on(table.identifier)],
)

// Library. A book's columns hold metadata read from its file and are owned by the
// scanner, which overwrites them whenever the file changes. Metadata from other
// sources (Phase 4 matching) goes in `matched` and wins field by field when read
// (see bookView in src/lib/books.ts), so a rescan never clobbers a match.
export const books = sqliteTable(
  'books',
  {
    id: text('id').primaryKey(),
    title: text('title').notNull(),
    sortTitle: text('sort_title').notNull(),
    authors: text('authors', { mode: 'json' })
      .$type<string[]>()
      .default(sql`'[]'`)
      .notNull(),
    description: text('description'),
    language: text('language'),
    publisher: text('publisher'),
    publishedDate: text('published_date'),
    isbn: text('isbn'),
    series: text('series'),
    seriesIndex: real('series_index'),
    // Relative to the data dir, e.g. covers/<id>.jpg.
    coverPath: text('cover_path'),
    matched: text('matched', { mode: 'json' }).$type<MatchedMetadata>(),
    // No file for this book was found by the last complete scan. Rows are kept.
    missing: integer('missing', { mode: 'boolean' }).default(false).notNull(),
    createdAt: integer('created_at', { mode: 'timestamp_ms' })
      .default(sql`(cast(unixepoch('subsecond') * 1000 as integer))`)
      .notNull(),
    updatedAt: integer('updated_at', { mode: 'timestamp_ms' })
      .default(sql`(cast(unixepoch('subsecond') * 1000 as integer))`)
      .$onUpdate(() => new Date())
      .notNull(),
  },
  (table) => [index('books_sort_title_idx').on(table.sortTitle)],
)

export const bookFiles = sqliteTable(
  'book_files',
  {
    id: integer('id').primaryKey({ autoIncrement: true }),
    bookId: text('book_id')
      .notNull()
      .references(() => books.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
    // Relative to the library dir, with forward slashes.
    path: text('path').notNull().unique(),
    size: integer('size').notNull(),
    mtimeMs: integer('mtime_ms').notNull(),
    // sha256 of the file; finds files that were moved or renamed.
    hash: text('hash').notNull(),
    format: text('format').notNull(),
    createdAt: integer('created_at', { mode: 'timestamp_ms' })
      .default(sql`(cast(unixepoch('subsecond') * 1000 as integer))`)
      .notNull(),
    updatedAt: integer('updated_at', { mode: 'timestamp_ms' })
      .default(sql`(cast(unixepoch('subsecond') * 1000 as integer))`)
      .$onUpdate(() => new Date())
      .notNull(),
  },
  (table) => [
    index('book_files_book_id_idx').on(table.bookId),
    index('book_files_hash_idx').on(table.hash),
  ],
)
import crypto from 'node:crypto'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import { betterAuth } from 'better-auth'
import { drizzleAdapter } from 'better-auth/adapters/drizzle'
import { admin, username } from 'better-auth/plugins'
import { tanstackStartCookies } from 'better-auth/tanstack-start'

import { db } from '#/db'
import { config } from '#/lib/config'

// BETTER_AUTH_SECRET wins; otherwise generate one on first boot and keep it in the data dir.
function loadSecret() {
  if (process.env.BETTER_AUTH_SECRET) return process.env.BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
  if (!fs.existsSync(config.secretPath)) {
    fs.writeFileSync(
      config.secretPath,
      crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex'),
      {
        mode: 0o600,
      },
    )
  }
  return fs.readFileSync(config.secretPath, 'utf8').trim()
}

export const auth = betterAuth({
  database: drizzleAdapter(db, { provider: 'sqlite' }),
  secret: loadSecret(),
  // With BOOKSERVE_URL unset, the base URL (and trusted origin) is taken from each request,
  // honoring X-Forwarded-Host/Proto from a reverse proxy. Cookies are then not marked Secure,
  // so plain-http LAN access works; setting an https BOOKSERVE_URL turns Secure cookies on.
  baseURL: config.publicUrl,
  advanced: {
    trustedProxyHeaders: true,
    ...(config.publicUrl ? {} : { useSecureCookies: false }),
  },
  emailAndPassword: {
    enabled: true,
    disableSignUp: true,
  },
  // Role changes and deletes go through the server functions in src/lib/user-functions.ts,
  // which refuse self-demotion/self-deletion and removing the last admin. Close the raw
  // HTTP endpoints that could bypass those guards (auth.api calls are unaffected).
  disabledPaths: [
    '/admin/set-role',
    '/admin/update-user',
    '/admin/remove-user',
  ],
  plugins: [username(), admin(), tanstackStartCookies()],
})

export const syntheticEmail = (name: string) =>
  `${name.toLowerCase()}@bookserve.local`
# Bookserve

A self-hosted ebook server. See `AGENTS.md` for the architecture and `docs/plan.md` for the roadmap.

## Run with Docker

```bash
docker build -t bookserve .
docker run -d --name bookserve -p 3000:3000 \
  -v /path/to/config:/config \
  -v /path/to/books:/books \
  bookserve
```

Open http://localhost:3000 and create the admin account. On first boot the container creates the database and an auth secret in `/config`.

| Variable                | Default (image) | Purpose                                                                                                      |
| ----------------------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `BOOKSERVE_DATA_DIR`    | `/config`       | Database, generated secret, caches                                                                           |
| `BOOKSERVE_LIBRARY_DIR` | `/books`        | Your books                                                                                                   |
| `BOOKSERVE_URL`         | unset           | Public URL, e.g. `https://books.example.com`. Unset: taken from each request (works behind a reverse proxy). |
| `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET`    | unset           | Overrides the secret generated in the data dir                                                               |
| `GOOGLE_BOOKS_API_KEY`  | unset           | Enables Google Books matching (keyless requests are rejected by Google)                                      |
| `PORT`                  | `3000`          | HTTP port                                                                                                    |

## Development

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm dev          # http://localhost:3000, data in ./data
pnpm lint
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build        # then: node .output/server/index.mjs
```

Schema changes: edit `src/db/schema.ts`, run `pnpm db:generate`, and commit the new file in `drizzle/`. Migrations apply automatically on startup.

Add UI components with `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add <component>`.
